metadata.title: G-Wagon Mechanic Reveals The Truth: Are They Ridiculously Expensive To Maintain?
metadata.description:
Are G Wagon's ridiculously expensive to maintain? This G-Wagon Mechanic reveals the common problems, maintenance costs, and more. 

Thanks to Joe, the G Wagon Expert at Alliance Auto Care in Loveland, CO, for helping prepare our FREE G-Wagon's Buyer's Guide: https://docs.google.com/document/d/12AuluAdmYzX5J3fkvwb2Vcos9EYJr1mSu7M1WzFkAhE/edit?usp=sharing
